project.apply.agree: I have reviewed the change and approve modifying {path}.
project.apply.needAgree: Explicit approval is required (tick the box).
project.apply.never: The workbench never touches lines outside the block or the vault configuration; it writes only when you click.
project.apply.noChange: No change: the file already contains it.
project.apply.title: Preview: {label}
project.chk.gitignoreMissing: _privat/ and the other sensitive patterns are not in .gitignore (managed block missing).
project.chk.gitignoreOk: The managed .gitignore block is present (_privat/, *_PHI* … excluded).
project.chk.history: A sensitive path is in the git history ({n} path(s)) — see the recommendations.
project.chk.historyOk: git history: no sensitive path was committed.
project.chk.historyUnchecked: The git history was not checked.
project.chk.hold: Write hold: data cannot be written until protection is in place.
project.chk.tracked: {n} sensitive file(s) already tracked in the git index (e.g. {first}).
project.chk.vaultNone: Vault does not track the project.
project.chk.vaultTracked: The folder is tracked by vault: it is pushed to GitHub at the end of the session.
project.class.A.desc: Aggregates extracted from publications (e.g. 2×2 cells, mean/SD). Location: 03_adatok/; may go to vault's private repo; Claude may read it; allowed in audit bundles and snapshots.
project.class.B.desc: Aggregates received from authors under confidentiality. Default location _privat/; vault push only with logged consent; Claude only if the agreement allows; excluded from audits by default.
project.class.C.desc: Patient-level data, anonymised only and only in _privat/. Vault push and Claude reading are forbidden (deny rule required); under the vault root it opens only with the .gitignore block and the pre-commit guard; never in audits or snapshots.
project.class.confirmBody: The project's data class becomes {from} → {to}. This changes the write hold and the recommended protections.
project.class.legend: The project's data class (the highest one present)
project.class.note: After choosing you see a preview of the privacy check under the new class. The change happens only after confirmation and is logged.
project.class.title: Data class
project.diff.label: Diff preview
project.init.cmd: Same as: python ma.py project init <folder> — creates the folder structure, ma-projekt.json and projekt.sqlite.
project.init.name: Title
project.init.title: New project (project init)
project.open.note: One workbench serves one project folder; for another folder start a new instance: python ma.py gui --project <folder>.
project.open.title: Open a project
project.privacy.title: Privacy check — {path}
project.uninit: The folder has no project log (projekt.sqlite) or ma-projekt.json yet: create them below (project init).
